item.title: City of Victoria receives $750K for youth safety and wellbeing program
item.description: Victoria has received $750,000 in federal funding to support a new initiative aimed at preventing crime and improving safety and wellbeing among young people in the city.

item.title: 5 things to do in and around Victoria this Friday, January 23rd
item.description: Whether you’re booking a table for Victoria’s biggest food festival, catching a comedy show, or dancing the night away, there’s no shortage of ways to get out and enjoy a Friday in town.

item.title: VicPD warns residents about a resurfaced credit card fraud scheme
item.description: VicPD is warning residents—specifically seniors—about a resurfaced credit card fraud scheme, following a report received on January 19th.

item.title: Province appoints housing adviser to help North Saanich meet housing targets
item.description: The BC government has appointed a housing adviser to work with the North Saanich after the municipality fell well short of its first-year housing targets

item.title: Keating Cross Road southbound on-ramp to Highway 17 set to open Saturday
item.description: Drivers in Central Saanich will see a major traffic change this weekend, as the Keating Cross Road southbound on-ramp to Highway 17 is set to reopen.

item.title: Nominations are open for the 2025 Greater Victoria Sports Awards
item.description: Nominations are now open for the Greater Victoria Sports Awards, which highlight the achievements of Greater Victoria athletes, teams, coaches and volunteers.

item.title: Wrong-way driver stopped on Pat Bay Highway early Thursday morning (VIDEO)
item.description: An elderly driver was taken to hospital early Thursday morning after being stopped for driving the wrong way on the Pat Bay Highway in Saanich.

item.title: Port Alberni man charged after armed robbery at Saanich bank
item.description: A man is facing robbery-related charges following an armed bank robbery in Saanich last week that ended with his arrest in Victoria.

item.title: Man in life-threatening condition after assault near Goldstream Park
item.description: A man remains in hospital with life-threatening injuries after a serious assault in Langford on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: 12 things to do in and around Victoria this weekend—January 24th and 25th
item.description: Welcome to the weekend—the last weekend of the month—and it's shaping up to be a busy one in Victoria.
